question.text: To a 25 mL H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub> solution, excess of acidified solution of potassium iodide was added. The iodine liberated required 20 mL of 0.3 N sodium thiosulphate solution. Calculate the volume strength of H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub> solution and report your answer by multiplying it with 1000.

solution.text:
Meq of H2O2 = Meq of I2 = Meq of Na2S2O3. 

If N is normality of H2O2, then
 
      N x 25 = 0.3 x 20,  N H 2 O 2 = 0 . 2 4 N
 
M H 2 O 2 = 0.12 M

N = 0.24

Volume strength = 0.12 × 11.2

                              =1.334 Vol

Final answer =1.334×1000=1334
